Do NOT send a JSON body — send empty body or no body. ALL data goes in the URL query string.

paidAmount is the full payment amount (e.g., 47200). For foreign currency, use paidAmountCurrency instead.
Requires name and departmentNumber.
ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.

jobTitle is set via PUT /employee/{id} AFTER creation — it cannot be set in the initial POST.

isInternal should be false unless explicitly stated as internal project.

For project activities, set activityType='PROJECT_GENERAL_ACTIVITY'.
Requires project={"id": project_id} and activity={"id": activity_id}.
If activity already linked (409), ignore the error and proceed.
If a default hourly rate already exists (409 Duplicate entry), GET /project/hourlyRates?projectId=... then PUT to update it.
For fixed rate: hourlyRateModel='TYPE_FIXED_HOURLY_RATE', fixedRate=<rate>.
Requires project, activity, employee, date, hours.

hours is a decimal number (e.g. 8.0, 7.5).

payload.headline: Project and invoice created but timesheets failed (wrong dates) and supplier voucher never succeeded
what_went_wrong: Timesheet entries used dates before project start (2026-03-22), causing 7 consecutive 422 errors. Agent should have used startDate=2026-03-22 from the beginning.
Batch timesheet POST /timesheet/entry/list also failed with 409 because the first entry (2026-03-22) was already created individually, blocking the whole batch.

Supplier voucher (POST /ledger/voucher) failed 3 times: first used bank account 1920 (locked to VAT 0), then used account.number without id, then provided name+number but still no valid account id — never looked up account 6400's actual id.
Agent exhausted enforcer overrides on timesheet retries and never successfully registered the 53h for Jade Martin or 56h for Louis Robert, causing checks 3, 4, 5, 6 to fail.
what_worked: Project creation, order, orderline, and invoice were all created successfully (checks 1, 2, 7 passed).
Existing entities (customer, supplier, both employees) were correctly identified via GET /employee and reused.
what_to_try_next: For timesheets: set project startDate to a past date (e.g. 2026-03-01) so hours can be spread across multiple days, OR use a single large-hour entry on the project start date — but never attempt dates before startDate.

For supplier voucher: first GET /ledger/account?number=6400 to retrieve the account id, then POST /ledger/voucher using account.id (not account.number or account.name) with correct debit/credit postings summing to zero.
Use POST /timesheet/entry/list for batch timesheet creation in one call (after ensuring no duplicate date conflicts), and do NOT create any individual entries first for the same date.
unnecessary_calls: POST /timesheet/entry with dates 2026-03-16 through 2026-03-20 and 2026-03-09/10 (7 calls) — all failed predictably since project start was 2026-03-22
POST /timesheet/entry on 2026-03-22 a second time (409 conflict) — duplicate of already-created entry
POST /ledger/voucher with account 1920 (422) — should have looked up correct expense account id first
